rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an informal conversation or chat.

example.english: We had a conversation while eating.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6 go2 zan6 king1 gai2

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing an exchange or dialogue between two or more people.

example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 deoi3 waa6 hou2 jau5 ji3 si1

rows.note: Use this for a somewhat formal or serious conversation rather than casual 傾偈.

example.english: The principal had a conversation with the parents.
example.traditional: 校長同家長進行咗一次談話。
example.jyutping: haau6 zoeng2 tung4 gaa1 zoeng2 zeon3 hang4 zo2 jat1 ci3 taam4 waa6

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal, written, or technical contexts for a conversation or conversational exchange.

example.english: This program can record a human-computer conversation.
example.traditional: 呢個程式可以記錄人機會話。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 ho2 ji5 gei3 luk6 jan4 gei1 wui6 waa6
